cases.name: fmt-mp4-h264-high-aac
cases.html:
<!DOCTYPE html><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#fff} video,audio{display:block}</style><script>
const L=[],SS=[],r2=x=>Math.round(x*100)/100,q=x=>Math.floor(x*2)/2;
const rg=t=>Array.from({length:t.length},(_,i)=>q(t.start(i))+'-'+q(t.end(i))).join(',');
const rg2=t=>Array.from({length:t.length},(_,i)=>r2(t.start(i))+'-'+r2(t.end(i))).join(',');
const ME=['loadstart','emptied','error','durationchange','loadedmetadata','loadeddata','canplay','canplaythrough','play','playing','waiting','pause','seeking','seeked','ended','volumechange'];
const CT=(m,e)=>e.type=='seeking'||e.type=='seeked'?r2(m.currentTime):Math.floor(m.currentTime);
function watch(m){ME.forEach(n=>m.addEventListener(n,e=>L.push(e.type+' p='+(+m.paused)+' ct='+CT(m,e)+(m.muted?' M':''))))}
const ST=()=>'p='+(+v.paused)+' e='+(+v.ended)+' ct='+q(v.currentTime)+' m='+(+v.muted)+' rs='+v.readyState+' ns='+v.networkState+' pl='+rg(v.played)+' sk='+(+v.seeking)+' err='+(v.error?v.error.code:0);
const SMP=n=>{SS.push(n+' '+ST())};
</script><video id=v src=a.mp4 controls width=320 height=240></video><script>watch(v)</script>
